verdict.line: You win the early trades and the solo kills, but Sett only closes this out 40.9% of the time over 149 games, so you lose if the lane goes long and Camille reaches her item spikes.

brief.thesis: Sett's E (Facebreaker) stuns anything pulled from opposite sides, which punishes Camille for walking her Q (Precision Protocol) auto-range into you, and Sett has the clear solo-kill edge in this matchup. But Camille's Hookshot (E) only has a 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown even at rank one, so her disengage comes back fast, and her passive Adaptive Defenses shield plus her R (The Hextech Ultimatum) isolating duels let her out-trade you once she has items. This is a matchup you have to win early — the win rate says it slips away if you let it scale.

theirWindow.when: Hookshot (E) is up near a wall
theirWindow.what: She can leap to a wall and knock you up on landing, then follow with an empowered Precision Protocol (Q) auto. Don't stand near ledges when her E icon is lit, and don't let her walk you into a wall-adjacent trade.

yourWindow.what: She has no gap-close and no escape for up to 16 seconds at early ranks. This is when you walk Q (Knuckle Down) onto her and force the fight — she has to trade flat-footed or run.

start.why: Run in 82% of games at 42.5% win rate. The extra sustain and auto-damage matter because you want to win short trades, not stall for scaling.

boots.why: Picked in 68.9% of games at 43.2% win rate. Camille auto-resets and Q-empowers her attacks, so flat physical reduction blunts her poke and all-in damage.

runes.keystoneWhy: The most-picked keystone for this matchup (43.9% of games) — stacking adaptive force through extended trades rewards the flat-footed all-ins you're forcing while Hookshot is down.

summoners.why: The standard pick at 88.4% of games and 42.8% win rate. You have the solo-kill advantage in this matchup, so Ignite converts skirmishes into kills before Camille's Adaptive Defenses shield or her passive healing lets her walk away.

playing.title: Track Hookshot cooldown, not her health
playing.detail: Her E is a 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown gap-close and knockup setup. When it's down, she has no escape — that's your all-in window, not her low HP.

playing.title: Position her between you and minions
playing.detail: Facebreaker (E) only stuns if she's pulled from opposite sides. If she's isolated on just one side of you, it slows instead. Force trades with a minion wave or wall behind her to guarantee the stun.

playing.title: Hold Haymaker for her empowered Q
playing.detail: Precision Protocol (Q) can be recast for a heavily boosted hit if she delays between casts. Bank your stored Grit and pop the W shield right as she commits to the recast.

playing.title: Punish her Q gap-close, not her Q poke
playing.detail: Her first Q hit is minor bonus damage and Move Speed — don't overreact to it. Save your aggression for the moment she's fully committed into range.

playing.title: Front-load your aggression before level 9
playing.detail: Your win rate curve says this lane is winnable early and loses value late. Use Q (Knuckle Down) and E off cooldown to force fights levels 3-8 rather than farming passively.

playing.title: Ult to end fights, not start them
playing.detail: Show Stopper (R) has a long 120/100/80/80/80s cooldown early — save it to lock down and finish a kill you've already started, not to open a neutral trade.

playing.title: Don't chase past her Hextech Ultimatum threat
playing.detail: Once she has R up, she can anchor you into a bonus-magic-damage duel on her terms. If Hookshot and R are both up, disengage instead of forcing another fight.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and every win-rate figure above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are this brief's own analysis, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit by Camille’s (E). Use your abilities off cooldown to close in and fight her. Use [W] when Camille uses (Q).
